<div class="description">
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<dl>
<dt>Enclosing class:</dt>
<dd><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline</a></dd>
</dl>
<hr>
<pre>public static final class <span class="typeNameLabel">MapPolyline.DashImageRepresentation</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Represents a dash pattern for the map polyline consisting of images rendered with certain gaps
 from each other.
 <p>This dash pattern representation consists only of images rendered at certain
 points along the polyline. For rendering them without any distortions, polyline gets sliced into
 series of straight segments that are multiple of sum of dash and gap lengths. For this
 reason, the new polyline geometry might not align fully with original geometry.
 <p>The <a href="#getDashImage()"><code>getDashImage()</code></a> is stretched according to <a href="#getDashLength()"><code>getDashLength()</code></a>
 and <a href="#getDashWidth()"><code>getDashWidth()</code></a>, with image's width matched to <code>dashLength</code> and
 image's height matched to <code>dashWidth</code>. The image is oriented so that its bottom is on the
 left-hand side between vertices <code>n</code> and <code>n+1</code>.
 <p>The spacing between images is specified by <a href="#getGapLength()"><code>getGapLength()</code></a>.
 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected
 behaviors. Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>DashImageRepresentation</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;DashImageRepresentation&#8203;(@NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;dashLength,
                               @NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;dashWidth,
                               @NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapimage" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapImage</a>&nbsp;image)
                        throws <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation.InstantiationException</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a uniform dash pattern in which the length of a gap is the same as the length of
 a dash. Dashes are rendered as image.
 <p>This allows for patterns like <code>' — — — —'</code> or <code>' —— —— ——'</code>.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</code></a> supplied for <code>dashLength</code> and <code>dashWidth</code>,
 only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> is supported for <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize#measureKind"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize.measureKind</code></a>
 and only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rendersize-unit#METERS"><code>RenderSize.Unit.METERS</code></a> is supported for <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize#sizeUnit"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize.sizeUnit</code></a>.
 <p>Only map measure values in range [3-19] are supported.
 <p>The value of the keys in <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize#sizes"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize.sizes</code></a> is truncated to integer values,
 hence only a single value can be provided per zoom level.
 <p>The values are interpolated linearly between zoom levels.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>dashLength</code> - <p>The map measure dependent length of a dash, to which image width is stretched.</dd>
<dd><code>dashWidth</code> - <p>The map measure dependent width of a dash, to which image height is stretched.</dd>
<dd><code>image</code> - <p>Image to be rendered in place of dash space. It is stretched to match <code>dashWidth</code> and <code>dashLength</code>.</dd>
<dt><span class="throwsLabel">Throws:</span></dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation.InstantiationException</a></code> - <p>In case of invalid input parameters.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="&lt;init&gt;(com.here.sdk.mapview.MapMeasureDependentRenderSize,com.here.sdk.mapview.MapMeasureDependentRenderSize,com.here.sdk.mapview.MapMeasureDependentRenderSize,com.here.sdk.mapview.MapImage)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>DashImageRepresentation</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;DashImageRepresentation&#8203;(@NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;dashLength,
                               @NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;gapLength,
                               @NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</a>&nbsp;dashWidth,
                               @NonNull
                               <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapimage" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapImage</a>&nbsp;image)
                        throws <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation.InstantiationException</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a simple dash pattern in which the lengths of a dash and gap can be different.
 Dashes are rendered as image.
 <p>This allows for patterns like <code>' — — — —'</code> or <code>' ——— ——— ———'</code>.
 <p>For <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize</code></a> supplied for <code>dashLength</code>, <code>gapLength</code> and <code>dashWidth</code>,
 only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> is supported for <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize#measureKind"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize.measureKind</code></a>
 and only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-rendersize-unit#METERS"><code>RenderSize.Unit.METERS</code></a> is supported for <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize#sizeUnit"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize.sizeUnit</code></a>.
 <p>Only map measure values in range [3-19] are supported.
 <p>The value of the keys in <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasuredependentrendersize#sizes"><code>MapMeasureDependentRenderSize.sizes</code></a> is truncated to integer values,
 hence only a single value can be provided per zoom level.
 <p>The values are interpolated linearly between zoom levels.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>dashLength</code> - <p>The map measure dependent length of a dash, to which image width is stretched.</dd>
<dd><code>gapLength</code> - <p>The map measure dependent length of a gap between dash images.</dd>
<dd><code>dashWidth</code> - <p>The map measure dependent width of a dash, to which image height is stretched.</dd>
<dd><code>image</code> - <p>Image to be rendered in place of dash space. It is stretched to match <code>dashWidth</code> and <code>dashLength</code>.</dd>
<dt><span class="throwsLabel">Throws:</span></dt>
<dd><code><a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mappolyline-representation-instantiationexception" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapPolyline.Representation.InstantiationException</a></code> - <p>In case of invalid input parameters.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
